sources: Type 50 Yinglung, 3 pieces: EquipSuitTable suit_atk02 → passive_equipsuit_atk_02 (equipCnt 3); SkillPatchTable atk_up 0.15 (in the panel), dmg_up 0.2, max_stack 3. Description: "Wearer's ATK +15%. When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Yinglung's Edge that gives DMG +20% to the wearer's next combo skill. Yinglung's Edge can stack 3 time(s)."

rmxlinux Json/BuffData: buff_equipsuit_atk_02 is an AuraAction on the team → buff_equipsuit_atk_02_aruadetect (ability event 30, CheckSkillType [2]: a battle skill cast) → buff_equipsuit_atk_02_addcombodamage on the wearer (stackingType 2, max max_stack, no duration). The wearer's next combo cast ([6]) turns the stacks into buff_equipsuit_atk_02_addcombodamage_buff: DMG + dmg_up × stacks (NormalCalcZone, decorate mask 8192, CheckSkillCastId: that cast only), and clears them.

Not logged by ZMDLogs. Si's combo slashes match with 2 stacks in fixtures/zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37.json (Si's and Camille's battle skills before the combo) and 3 stacks in fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json, with Jade Vessel's combo bonus (see Si's kit).

buffs.label: Yinglung's Edge
buffs.note: Layered: one layer per team battle-skill cast, up to max_stack (3), no duration; the wearer's next combo cast consumes every layer and they act on its hits (dmg_up each).

triggers.note: Any team member's battle-skill cast. Battle-skill sub-skills (Si's Initial and Final Stroke, normalSkillSubType 1) count here too: whether CheckSkillType [2] sees them is open (in-game test 29).
